climatology: per-pixel calendar-month statistics; minimum 5 observations per pixel-month

definitions.median5: forecast or truth exceeds 1.05 times the per-pixel annual median; auxiliary regime diagnostic, not treated as rare
definitions.percentile: forecast or truth exceeds the per-pixel calendar-month P90
definitions.zscore: calendar-month standardized anomaly exceeds 1.5 for truth; forecast cutoff calibrated on 2022

forecast_cutoff_calibration: cutoffs maximize F1 using only 2022 validation predictions from models fitted only on 2021
cumulative_sum_status: deferred to full-grid annual inference; not valid on the sparse supervised sample
